children: Dell Technologies shares trade higher after-hours, as the company reports revenue reaching a record high of $46.97 billion and lifts its full-year revenue outlook by $25 billion at the midpoint. The results were driven by demand for both traditional servers and networking and servers optimized for artificial-intelligence. Dell now forecasts AI-optimized server revenue hitting $74 billion in the current fiscal year, up from a previous view of $60 billion. Shares gain 10% to $468 after the close of regular trading. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
